verdict: key consistent: one sign per letter, every repeated letter takes the same sign except the first alif of الارض (S9, otherwise ض). Breaks are local: the start (S1 bare stroke before فكل) and the شك group (S3 ك written twice, S12 two-dot stem extra), and مصرا written without its final alif.
notes: Rows are the segmenter's lines 11-13 of image 0084_0017 (folio lines 11-13). Signs counted by eye: 17 + 14 + 10 = 41 (the record's 41; its per-row 18/12/11 split differs because the segmenter puts the row-11 stem-with-one-dot S3 and the row-12 opening S3 in different rows/boxes; a paper crack in row 11 is boxed by the segmenter and is not a sign). Dividers (stem with three dots): 9 seen; word groups by dividers 4|4|5|9|3|3|3|4|2|4: لا شك جنه are written as one group of 9 signs (no divider). Surplus placement: S1 (bare stroke) put at the start of فكل because S2-S3-S4 already give ف ك ل with ك = S3 and ل = S4 as elsewhere; in the 9-sign group, لا = S4 S7 and جنه = S13 S14 S15 are certain, leaving S3 S11 S3 S12 for شك: ش = S11 and ك = S3 (the S3 of row 12, matching فكل), the first S3 taken as an anticipated ك and S12 as an extra; other placements (S12 = ك, S3 a one-dot divider) are possible and change no repeated-shape count except S3. مصرا: three signs for four letters, the final alif not written. S9 (٢-like) is ض twice (الارض, بضعه) and once stands where ا is expected (first letter of الارض); it may be a ٣ with one tooth dropped.
